pf_preflight.global_state_gate: If PF is Disabled, pfctl -E may enable the existing loaded system ruleset, which has scope beyond port 56389. The apply script therefore requires live PF status, live main-rule inspection showing com.apple/*, exact child-anchor enumeration through -a com.apple -s Anchors, exact-anchor emptiness/unoccupation, a proof that root filter/NAT/queue rules are limited to the known Apple anchor, and a free 56389 before any apply. Unknown state, DIOCGETRULES stderr, or unreadable global state fails closed.
admin_apply_plan_not_executed: From a secure admin terminal with sudo credentials already cached, run the script default preflight and inspect its separate stdout/stderr/exit results.

The explicit --apply path calls pfctl -E, records separate owner-only stdout/stderr receipts, and accepts only one strict Token value across both streams before loading the unique anchor; missing, malformed, or conflicting Token lines retain review state.
Load only com.apple/comsol-mcp-56389 with the reviewed four-line rule file. No global ruleset reload or flush is used.

Require a recorded load-attempted/load-confirmed state and live exact-anchor rule hash. If any receipt/hash/cleanup state cannot be confirmed, preserve the owner-only token/state and report admin review.

rollback_plan_not_executed: Require the dedicated listener to be stopped.
